NOTIFY_LEFT_ON_SPOT: Vehicles left on a garage spot are towed after {0} minutes.
ADMIN_TAB_CLEANUP_DESC: What happens to vehicles players drive and leave behind in the world.
ADMIN_C_CLEANUP_DESC: When the last player driver gets out, the vehicle gets a time limit; a driver getting back in cancels it. Vehicles with a player inside, trailers and trains are never removed.
ADMIN_H_CLEANUP: Off: vehicles players leave stay until the server restarts.
ADMIN_H_SCOPE: Owned vehicles are the ones players bought or that belong to a job or gang.
ADMIN_H_ABANDON: Minutes after the driver got out, for a vehicle left anywhere but a garage spot.
ADMIN_H_OWNED_TO: Garage: the garage of the spot the vehicle was left on; a vehicle left elsewhere, or one the garage refuses, goes to the impound.
ADMIN_H_SCAN: How often the server looks at who drives what. Shorter notices quick rides; longer costs less on big servers.
ADMIN_C_SPOTS_DESC: Parking areas where a left vehicle is removed sooner, so it goes back where it belongs.
ADMIN_H_GARAGE_MINUTES: Minutes after the driver got out, for a vehicle left on a garage spot.
ADMIN_H_NOTIFY: The driver who leaves a vehicle on a garage spot is told when it will be towed.
ADMIN_H_SPOT_GARAGE: The garage script's id of this garage (ai-garages: the garage's key). Empty: the spot only shortens the time.
ADMIN_C_KEEP_DESC: Vehicles that are never removed, and vehicles the game must not take away.
ADMIN_H_KEEP_DRIVEN: A street vehicle a player drives stays in the world when no player is near, until it is removed as a left vehicle.
